annotations.title: Get the link that lists a game

description: For a browser game's play link, returns the foundplay.io link that lists it for free, with the form filled in, plus what happens next and free ways to get players. If the game is already listed, returns its page instead. Listing needs the person to sign in with their email; the game goes live right away. Read-only: nothing is listed until the person publishes.

playUrl.description: Where people play the game, starting with https://.
